skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Her Aspiration
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Her Aspiration. The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.
skins.quote: The faint light of the stars is unable to penetrate the depths of the darkness, but she firmly believes that the light she's after will be enough to illuminate every nook and cranny of this land.
